status: CANDIDATE BASELINE: CLOSURE TIMED FROM THE AID01104 LANE READINGS, DRIVERS REROUTE WHILE EVERY LANE IS CLOSED. NOT YET A VALIDATED INCIDENT REPLAY

assumptions.choice: Inputs are Simulation's 7 Oct P0 packet, unchanged: results/twin/oct07-p0-replay-inputs.zip at 4ec5afe on sim/e1-evaluation-correctness, SHA-256 52b298aa73eb7e8621fce28223fc6b798100979f5735d0605ee62c2198b68505. Flow-balance demand from PR #46 (647b13c), no speed signs, SUMO default drivers.
assumptions.status: model choice; the no-closure version of this setup scored 96.3% GEH<5 but 40.1% speed MAPE

assumptions.choice: The slow lane, 44419212_0, closes at 08:54:00 (5,340 s).
assumptions.status: observed at AID01104: first of five readings in a row with no slow-lane vehicle while the fast lane carried traffic; the last reading with it open was 08:50:30

observed at AID01104: every lane empty from 09:00:30. Single readings at 09:09, 09:14 and 09:30:30 show a few vehicles (17 in the five-minute counts 09:05-09:30); E does not model them. TD's 'all lanes' message came at 09:36

assumptions.choice: Reopening is set by --clearance, counted from the 08:54 onset. 66 minutes gives 10:00:00.
assumptions.status: observed at AID01104: last empty reading 09:59:30, traffic again at 10:00:00. TD reported the incident over at 10:02

assumptions.choice: TD's messages time what an operator could know, not the closure: first report 09:01, all lanes 09:36, end 10:02.
The whole 543 m edge lane is closed by setting its speed limit to zero, as in src/twin/run_scenario.py.
assumptions.status: spatial approximation; the crash position on the edge is not observed

assumptions.choice: Queue path AID01104: from the downstream end of edge 44419212 back along the main eastbound route to the network entry on Aberdeen Praya Road.
Corridor travel time: vehicles from the Aberdeen Praya Road entry (1197689855) over the flyover (44419212) to the Canal Road Flyover exit (485146382).
Emergency route: fastest free-flow path in this network from Aberdeen Praya Road (edge 1197441895) by Shek Pai Wan Road to the northbound Pok Fu Lam Road edge nearest Queen Mary Hospital (944309310).
assumptions.status: CANDIDATE, NOT REVIEWED. The hospital's position is not from a repository source. Only 8 of the 40 edges carry modelled traffic, so the figure is close to free-flow time

assumptions.choice: Residential streets are edges tagged highway.residential or highway.living_street in the OSM-built network.
assumptions.status: OSM tags, not a land-use survey

assumptions.choice: While both lanes are closed (09:00:30 to reopening), a driver entering the last 330 m before the fork (edges 814979901#0 to 1198059120) whose route crosses the flyover takes another route; SUMO picks it. The only one is Wong Chuk Hang Road under the flyover. Nobody reroutes earlier, further upstream, or while a lane is open.
assumptions.status: assumed behaviour, supported by the detectors: AID01103 before the fork kept passing 350-550 veh/h and AID01106 past the flyover counted 895 vehicles in ten bins while the flyover itself (AID01104) counted 17. How many drivers turned off further upstream is not observed
